title: Add a discount code feature across cart and pricing
description: Add support for percentage discount codes. app/pricing.py must gain apply_discount(total, code) which applies 10 percent for code SAVE10, 25 percent for SAVE25, and raises ValueError for an unknown code. app/cart.py's checkout() must accept an optional code argument and route the total through apply_discount when a code is supplied.
acceptanceCriteria: app/cart.py checkout accepts an optional code and applies the discount
brief: A small Python shopping cart package.
